how_a_design_target_constrains_a_fit.constraint_on_fit_values: NONE. A design target is an ASPIRATIONAL outcome, not a measurement of any built system: it has ZERO falsification power (no model output can be tested against it — a model predicting below a target has not 'missed' anything, because nothing was achieved to miss), it can seed NO fit objective, NO tolerance, and NO swept-value provenance. This stage derives no fitted value from GF-09 and asserts that none may ever be
how_a_design_target_constrains_a_fit.normalization_only_use: the CAL-A1/A2 discipline, with the OPPOSITE bounding direction: CAL-A1/A2 are spec CEILINGS (achieved values stay below them), while '400+ Gbps' is an open-ended class FLOOR — the '+' states no upper bound at all. It therefore bounds the admissible scale of any future UEC-PROFILE configuration from below (a UEC-profile run at B < 50 B/ns under the declared per-direction reading would sit below the design class its profile names), and bounds nothing from above. The sub-microsecond latency target (boundary edge 1000 ns) and the 10 us target RTT (5000 ns charged as 2L) locate the LATENCY REGIME a UEC-profile model must operate in — as context, never as achieved or achievable values
